name: Πυργάκι
round1Evidence: Guides state Pyrgaki has umbrellas and sunbeds ('διαθέτει ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες') alongside its quiet shallow-water character.

name: Όρμος Υστερνίων
round1Evidence: Travel piece on Ormos Ysternion Tinos: visitors sit 'κάτω από τα αλμυρίκια και τις ψάθινες ομπρέλες' — straw umbrellas on the beach, fish tavernas right on the water; no explicit sunbed rental mention.

name: Λιμάνι Παναγιάς
round1Evidence: Municipality of Karpathos lists Limani Panagias (Lefkos) as 'Organized beach with umbrellas and taverns'; other guides note it has a few umbrellas and sunbeds (not enough for everyone).

name: Προτοκάραβος
round1Evidence: Protokaravos (Kefalos, Kos) 'is organized with umbrellas and sunbeds in some areas', divided into two sections, otherwise quiet and wild.

name: Παραλία Λεύκες
round1Evidence: Patmosweb on Lefkes: 'Λίγο πριν τον Κάμπο (Υπάρχει καντίνα)' — a canteen operates at the beach; no sunbeds/umbrellas mentioned.

name: Παραλία Αλυκή
round1Evidence: Coordinate disambiguation corrected round1: lat 36.108/lng 27.730 is the WEST coast below Monolithos, Rhodes — matching Greeka's 'Just below the village of Monolithos, about 75 km southwest of Rhodes Town'. Greeka: 'Alyki Beach is unorganized, however you will find a handful of sunbeds available for rent'; Tripadvisor reviews confirm 'a dozen umbrellas with sunbeds for rent' run by a named manager. 'No shops or canteens in the area' — sunbed/umbrella rental yes, no bar/canteen. Minimal operation (a dozen sets).

name: Παραλία Διόνι
round1Evidence: Dioni at Katochi/Acheloos mouth (Oiniades) — agriniopress cites 'the beach bar Navagio' as a main draw, and 'Mammos Beach Bar Dioni Katochi' operates there since 2022 (its own Facebook page). Beach bar confirmed at this exact locality; no explicit sunbed evidence (local article mentions only sandy/shallow), so sunbeds left null.

name: Παραλία Πλατανίτη
round1Evidence: Nafpaktia municipality/local guides describe Platanitis (4 km from the Rio-Antirrio bridge) as organized with restaurants, cafes and sunbeds.

name: ΠΔΕ Πάτρα Αγ.Βασίλειος
round1Evidence: Agios Vasileios (Rio, Patras) described as largely organized with umbrellas and loungers, beach bars along the coast, plus a Seatrac access ramp.

name: Παραλία Λεβεντοχωρίου
round1Evidence: Pyrgos hoteliers/Visit Olympia listings: beach has umbrellas, loungers, WC, showers and a canteen with tables serving swimmers.

name: Γλυφά
round1Evidence: Glyfa (Alonissos) has fine white pebble and umbrellas with sunbeds at its southern end.

name: Παραλία Βότση
round1Evidence: Votsi cove described as organized with umbrellas and sunbeds; tavernas in the small harbor village.

name: Τσουκαλιά
round1Evidence: Tsoukalia (largest north-side beach) has a few sunbeds and umbrellas plus a canteen for essentials.

name: Πάλτση
round1Evidence: Pelioxenia's dedicated Paltsi page (SE Pelion 13km from Argalasti, matches pin): 'During July and August, you'll find sunbeds and parasols available, along with open tavernas serving fresh seafood' — explicit seasonal sunbeds plus two tavernas behind the beach. No beach bar documented; organized = seasonal sunbeds + tavernas only.
